name: UK inflation & rates
summary: UK CPI rose to 3.6% in October from 3.5%; Bank Rate raised to 4% in November with a December rise priced
state: The ONS reported on 18 Nov that CPI rose 3.6% in the 12 months to October, up from 3.5%, with motor fuels the largest upward driver (ONS; ITV News). That sits inside the 2.5–4.0% Watch band. The Bank of England raised Bank Rate to 4% on 5 Nov, its first rise since 2023 and a reversal of its earlier cutting course, and markets price a further rise in December. The flash UK composite PMI eased to 52.3 in November on 23 Nov.
for_you: Higher inflation and a rising Bank Rate mean dearer borrowing; tracker and new fixed mortgage rates tend to follow. Savings rates usually rise too.
rubric_hit: CPI 3.6% in 2.5–4.0% Watch band; BoE reversed course with a rise to 4%
